description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md). TinyWhisper iqmod_top (two MFB LPF + SPDT + passive 25 % mixers) on sky130 (rule D7), VDD 1.5 V. Conditions = the repository's supply sweep 1.2/1.5/1.8 V (tt, 27 C) plus the two schematic test variants (250 kohm source resistance; 650 ohm load). Targets = repository values (10 % linear tolerance), schematic values where both schematic and PEX exist (G5); Monte Carlo = the repository's mismatch-only statistics. No objective. Fixtures follow the repository's testbenches (commit ad6cbaf): iqmod_top_tb_tran (100 % PWM PWL data, coupled-resonator LC band-pass 1k_1k, Rload 1 kohm, Cload 10 pF, 10 ps 25 % LO) and iqmod_top_tb_ac / iqmod_mfb_lpf_tb_* (all LO and SPDT controls high, Cload 10 pF on each output, CMRR with CM-to-CM gain).

source.doi: none (open-source design; github.com/iic-jku/TinyWhisper commit ad6cbaf, release v2026.08, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22115125)
source.title: TinyWhisper iqmod_top: IQ modulator (2 x 3rd-order MFB Butterworth LPF, fc 400 kHz, inverter-based OTA; SPDT input switches; 2 passive mixers, 4-phase 25 % LO), S. Dorrer, JKU
source.figure: source/Schematics/00_hierarchy.txt and 01_L0_iqmod_top.png (the netlist is the whole iqmod_top hierarchy: 48 device lines in 22 cells, 456 MOSFETs when expanded)
